task_summary: Customer reports that the Glass Coffee Carafe from order ORD-6023 arrived damaged due to shipping. The correct handling is to process a shipping-damage return: review the shipping and return policy, provide a full refund to the original payment method, issue a return label, and, if the item is classified as fragile, apply the additional fragile-item goodwill credit as applicable.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must issue the separate $10 fragile-item goodwill credit to original payment.

opening_message: Hi, I received my Glass Coffee Carafe from order ORD-6023, but it arrived damaged. The box was crushed, and the carafe is broken.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You received a Glass Coffee Carafe from order ORD-6023 that was damaged during shipping. You want a refund to the original payment method. If the item is fragile, you should ask whether a separate fragile-item goodwill credit applies.
known_info: You purchased a Glass Coffee Carafe in order ORD-6023.
The item arrived damaged, with crushed packaging.
unknown_info: You do not know the internal item_id unless the agent provides it.
task_rules: Keep the issue strictly about shipping damage; do not request a changed-mind return, cancellation, warranty claim, or exchange.
After receiving a valid preview of the damaged-in-transit return, if the item is fragile, expect the separate goodwill credit to be included.
